description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Charming Beach Bungalow!* Short Walk to Dogwood Beach Access* 4 Beach Chairs Included* Covered Outdoor Area with Grilling and Dining* Pet Friendly (add'l $300 fee)* Easy Access to the Timpoochee Trail and 30A Bike Path* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, pool/spa heater controls, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door and pool area.*Dogwood Bungalow sits on coastal pilings and offers a spacious layout perfect for relaxing and making lasting memories. This charming 4-bedroom, 2-bath single-level home is located just three homes from the sandy beach, making beach days incredibly convenient, four beach chairs are included for you. Back at the home, the covered outdoor area provides a shaded space for grilling, outdoor dining, and relaxing with family and friends. With comfortable living spaces, an open-concept kitchen and dining area, and plenty of room for everyone to spread out, Dogwood Bungalow is the perfect home base for your next 30A vacation.The Bed Setup:Guest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Loft Bed + Twin DaybedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
